name: virtual-cafe
description: Virtual Cafe - your favorite cafe, always within reach

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others --success first "npm run dev -w @virtual-cafe/server" "npm run dev -w @virtual-cafe/web"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run free-ports && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @virtual-cafe/server && npm run build -w @virtual-cafe/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others --success first "npm run start -w @virtual-cafe/server" "npm run start -w @virtual-cafe/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @virtual-cafe/server && npm run typecheck -w @virtual-cafe/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @virtual-cafe/server
